system.description:
Lore: Relic Spellbook

Sigil of Iriolarthas, a Netherese lich whose library survived the fall of Ythryn far better than he did.

A heavy spellbook bound in black leather studded with dead, varnished worms, sealed with a gold rune shaped like a candle-flame eye. A spellcaster who spends a Shift studying it adds the following Spells to those they know, if they don't already: Animate, Confuse, Control, Disintegrate, Portal, and Raise.

It has the following Powers:

  • Iriolarthas's Curriculum: A Caster who studies it for a Shift adds @UUID[Compendium.vagabond-rpg.spells.Item.wD2EtvR22pIWlMqU]{Animate}, @UUID[Compendium.vagabond-rpg.spells.Item.tYMBjaX72424BZPW]{Confuse}, @UUID[Compendium.vagabond-rpg.spells.Item.pI3ezwxfgAetuy3w]{Control}, @UUID[Compendium.vagabond-rpg.spells.Item.plviZS0VEOdMNLkC]{Disintegrate}, @UUID[Compendium.vagabond-rpg.spells.Item.Yn7Qxij2UYVw5Djl]{Portal} and @UUID[Compendium.vagabond-rpg.spells.Item.lFubEdpr4iGi8BMw]{Raise} to the Spells they know, if they can Cast at that Rank.

Value: 1500g
system.source: Icewind Dale: Rime of the Frostmaiden (Vagabond conversion)
